candidate_sample.method: Five mutually exclusive assigned strata with 20 pages each. Existing completed scan-review work is forced into an eligible stratum, then remaining places use ascending SHA-256 keys based on seed, stratum, file_id, and page_number.

rejected_file_sample.method: Select the 50 rejected files with the smallest SHA-256 keys based on seed and file_id. This is deterministic, order independent, and requires one pass through the full pinned corpus.
rejected_file_sample.page_choice: Within each sampled file, retain the OCR page with the highest count of exact-filter and related near-match terms; ties favor longer OCR text.

notes: The original notebook did not pin a dataset revision. The revision recorded here is the commit cached when the notebook outputs were inspected.
Manual verification columns are blank. Prior reviewed values and notes are retained in separately labeled prior_* columns.
